title: Super cute lunchbox but pricey.
text: Super cute lunchbox but pricey.. This Very Bradley lunchbox is super cute. It has black quilted/twill fabric with a silver zipper. There is a window on the side that you can put your business card in. The inside is lined/insulated. The only issue I have with this lunchbox is the price. On Amazon it runs about $39, which is expensive especially since there is no drink holder or special compartments. It literally can hold an average size lunch: salad, yogurt and piece of fruit OR sandwich, chips and a cookie. So besides being cute, this isn’t worth the money. 3 stars
